en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: In this course, students will acquire a complete knowledge of manufacturing methods, assortment, quality and evaluation. They also will learn about legislative requirements concerning production of cheese on farms.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction into cheesemaking (allowance 2/2)2.Quality of cow, goat, sheep, and buffalo milk used for cheesemaking (allowance 2/2)3.Treatment of milk used for cheesemaking (allowance 2/2)4.Rennets (allowance 2/2)5.Cultures for cheesemaking (allowance 2/2)6.Cheese ageing (allowance 2/2)7.Making of acid coagulated cheese (allowance 2/2)8.Making of sweet coagulated cheese (allowance 2/2)9.Manufacturing of fresh and termised cheese (allowance 2/2)10.Manufacturing of semi-hard and hard cheese (allowance 2/2)11.Manufacturing of mould cheese (allowance 2/2)12.Manufacturing of cheese specialities (allowance 2/2)13.Manufacturing of processed cheese (allowance 2/2)14.Whey processing (allowance 2/2)
